en.description:
Zombie Isles is a complete survival game for Apple Watch, iPhone, and iPad. The full game is on every device, with controls built for each one: the Digital Crown on your wrist, and thumb-sized controls with a wide camera on phone and tablet. Your progress follows you everywhere.

NEW IN 1.3
Our biggest update yet: over 20 game modes, including Manhunt, Hide and Seek, Live Duel, Simon Says, Zombie Hunt, and an Obstacle Course. A 25-floor Gauntlet, 11 disasters, 203 achievements, 148 characters, 36 seasonal zombies, Worldwide Leaderboards, and Spanish!

CLASSIC
Survive endless waves of zombies across nine islands, finding unique weapons and secret items. Fight bosses on land and sea, or take on hardcore zombies with only your fists. Try Special Classic, where a hunter pack tracks you, or Tasked Classic, a race against the clock.

MANHUNT — NEW
One runner against a pack of armed hunters. Survive five minutes as the prey, or join the hunt and land the final blow yourself.

HIDE AND SEEK — NEW
Hide from Seekers with flashlights, or carry the light yourself. In Scary Mode, hiders creep closer in the dark and freeze in your beam.

LIVE DUEL — NEW
Battle real players in a live 1v1 on iPhone and iPad, with rematches and Best of 3.

ARENA
Endless waves in the torch-lit Arena, each harder than the last. No breaks, no chests!

BOSS BATTLE
Face a colossal boss with its own powers and three phases. A new boss arrives every hour. Defeat one to claim its exclusive skin.

DEFENSE
Zombies are gunning for the generator, and it's your job to stop them. Special Defense goes from Easy to Insane.

GAUNTLET
Earn Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary powers as you climb, stack your build, and face the Gatekeeper on floor 25.

DISASTERS
Fight the horde through tornadoes, blizzards, hurricanes, and more. Eleven deadly disasters. Can you survive them all?

RATED & TOURNAMENTS
Duel a zombie that matches your size, speed, health, and damage, so only the smarter fighter wins. Climb the rating ladder, fight into tournaments, or take on a 1v3, 1v5, or 1v10.

SABOTEUR
Find the rogue zombie hiding in the crowd. Follow the clues, but one wrong kill and you lose!

SHOWDOWN
100 rivals across twelve islands. Scavenge, outrun the storm, and be the last one standing.

CAPTURE THE FLAG
Lead your squad, steal the enemy flag, and run it home. Every July, compete in the CTF World Championships.

HORDE NIGHT
Pick 3, 5, or 10 minutes and hold out until dawn as the horde grows.

KING OF THE ISLE
Hold the crown zone for as long as you can while the horde keeps getting angrier.

AND MORE
Undercover, Lucky mode, Practice with custom settings, and a Prize Vault full of exclusive skins.

FEATURES

Over 20 game modes
Progress synced across Apple Watch, iPhone, and iPad
Dozens of zombie types, plus rare DARK variants and ultra-rare finds
Boss trophy skins and golden characters
Swords, bows, spears, hammers, axes, and gadgets like dynamite and frost grenades
Rating ladder, 32-fighter tournaments, and Worldwide Leaderboards
Daily quests, login streaks, and special event days
English and Spanish, plus Colorblind Mode
Play offline anytime, with no ads
SCAVENGE • FIGHT • SURVIVE
Made by Arman Brewer
Music by FedoraNoob

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Hi! Hope you have been enjoying Zombie Isles so far. Zombie Isles 1.2 just dropped.
New in 1.2:
-Now on iPhone and iPad!
Thats right, you can now also play Zombie Isles on your phone or iPad. The whole game is there, with controls built for a bigger screen.
-Your progress follows you
Play on your watch, pick it up on your phone. Coins, levels, unlocks and characters all stay in sync across your devices.
-Two brand new gamemodes!
HORDE NIGHT - pick 3, 5 or 10 minutes and a difficulty, then survive until dawn. The night only gets darker and the horde only gets bigger.
KING OF THE ISLE - hold the crown zone while the whole island tries to take it from you. Step outside and your reign is over. Endless, and the horde only gets angrier.
-New and updated gamemodes!
Rated, Showdown, and Saboteur are now new and updated with cool features.
RATED - your opponent is now a true mirror of you. Same health, same damage, same cooldowns. They swap between bow and sword depending on the range, and a well timed shield will parry you cold. Rating is friendlier too, so a bad run wont undo a good week. And no more sneaking out of a duel you are losing.
SABOTEUR - when the round ends, the camera now flies over and zooms right in on the imposter, so you always find out who it was.
-Daily Tasks and Daily Events
Every day, get one of 7 rotating daily events, like double coins, meteor shower, and more. Also, you get three tasks every day to complete. Currently only for iPhone and iPad.
-Rare Events
Every once in a while, you will get rare event, like Trillionaire Tuesday and Fortune Friday! Currently only for iPhone and iPad.
-Login streaks
Come back each day and the rewards get bigger, all the way up to a 7 day streak. Currently only for iPhone and iPad.
-A What's New screen
Tap it right from the menu to see everything that shipped and whats coming next. Now on Apple Watch too.
-Fixes and polish
Bigger, easier to read text on iPad. HUD text no longer hides behind the clock on Apple Watch. Plus a pile of smaller fixes all over the game.
Thanks for playing!
Hello guys! Hope you are enjoying Zombie Isles so far! This update just fixes a couple of glitches in the game. Nothing big.

Zombie Isles 1.3 is our biggest update ever!

NEW MODES

- Manhunt: one runner against a pack of armed hunters. Survive five minutes, or join the hunt and land the final blow yourself.
- Hide and Seek: hide from flashlight Seekers, or carry the light and find every hider. Scary Mode lets hiders creep closer in the dark.
- Live Duel: real-time 1v1 against real players on iPhone and iPad, with rematches and Best of 3.
- Special Classic: no horde, just a hunter pack tracking you down.
- Tasked Classic: race the clock through a checklist, from Easy to Insane.
- Simon Says, Zombie Hunt, and a 10-level Obstacle Course.
- Special Defense now has Easy to Insane difficulty.

GAMEPLAY

- The Gauntlet now goes 25 floors deep, with Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary powers and a tough Gatekeeper at the end.
- 11 disasters, up from 7.
- Bosses get stronger with their stars, telegraph attacks more fairly, and can actually heal.
- Capture the Flag World Championships, one week every July.
- More Saboteur clues, with a Hints switch.
- Much deeper Practice settings.
- Music in every mode.

ZOMBIES

- 36 seasonal zombies, three new ones every month.
- The Ravager, Dreadnought, and Harbinger appear once you've slain enough zombies.
- Ultra-rare finds like the Celebrity and the Comet.
- Dark versions of the new zombies, plus fuller boss pages in the Zombie Guide.

REWARDS

- 203 achievements, with prizes that match how hard they are.
- 148 collectible characters.
- Better level-ups, rebalanced prices, and richer lifetime stats, including your highest rating ever.
- Treasure Wednesday, bounty days, and more special event days.

RATING & LEADERBOARDS

- Worldwide Leaderboards: Daily through Lifetime, Rating, and friends.
- Smaller rating swings in duels. 1v3, 1v5, and 1v10 losses are tiny, and smaller the more you kill.
- Saboteur, Undercover, Hide and Seek, and Capture the Flag never affect rating.

APPLE WATCH

- Quick Play from your watch face.
- Respect Silent Mode, on by default.
- Smoother play, Less Auto Lag, and auto-save every 45 seconds.

EVERYWHERE

- Now in Spanish!
- Colorblind Mode.
- A Save button plus auto-save.
- Event Alerts.

 And tons more!
Just fixing the leaderboards rated matches, and some other small bugs. Hope you are enjoying 1.3 so far!
